name: Analyze Google Analytics
description: Provides a plugin for analyzing Google Analytics data.
project_description: Analyze Google Analytics is a submodule of Analyze that ships a single Analyze plugin, GoogleAnalytics (id "analytics"), which surfaces Google Analytics data for the entity being viewed on its Analyze tab. It reads results from a bundled View (analyze_google_analytics) whose base table is the google_analytics data provided by the Google Analytics Reports API module, argued by the entity's URL alias. The summary table shows page views, page views per user and bounce rate for the last period; a full report lists all returned GA metrics. The analyzer is only applicable once Google Analytics Reports is configured and imported, and its display is gated by the google_analytics_reports permission access google analytics reports. Depends on analyze, views, google_analytics_reports and google_analytics_reports_api.
